children: Velodrome Finance has announced that VELO is planned to cease trading on Binance by 13 Sep 2026, in preparation for the unification of Aerodrome and Velodrome into a single token, Aero. The delisting removes VELO's major centralized exchange venue.

Losing Binance access concentrates VELO trading on smaller venues, which typically widens spreads and deepens price sensitivity in the weeks before a delisting. Holders who want exposure to the unified Aero token must reposition ahead of the deadline, and that forced migration can amplify volatility as the date approaches. The move is procedural rather than punitive: it reflects the token consolidation, but the practical effect is reduced liquidity and fewer on-ramps for VELO until the unification completes.
The VELO token is also planned to cease trading on Binance this week, in preparation.

title: Velodrome Finance: VELO to cease trading on Binance ahead of Aero unification - By 13 Sep 2026
